before.source:
C4Context
  title Shop context
  Person(customer, "Customer", "Buys products")
  Enterprise_Boundary(company, "Shop company") {
    System(shop, "Shop", "Sells products online")
    System(reports, "Reporting", "Summarises orders")
  }
  System_Ext(provider, "Payment provider", "Charges cards")
  Rel(customer, shop, "Uses")
  Rel(shop, provider, "Charges", "HTTPS")
  Rel(shop, reports, "Sends orders")
before.description: Synthetic shop context before the change.
steps: Read the native C4 source and its exact authored markers.
Drill only through the declared child levels.

C4Container
  title Shop containers (before)
  Container_Boundary(shop, "Shop") {
    Container(api, "API", "Go", "Accepts orders")
    ContainerDb(db, "Database", "PostgreSQL", "Stores orders")
  }
  Rel(api, db, "Writes", "SQL")
steps: Read the native C4 source and its exact authored markers.

after.source:
C4Container
  title Shop containers (after)
  Container_Boundary(shop, "Shop") {
    Container(api, "API", "Go", "Accepts orders")
    Container(admin, "Admin app", "TypeScript", "Re-sends orders")
    ContainerQueue(queue, "Order queue", "NATS", "Buffers orders")
    ContainerDb(db, "Database", "PostgreSQL", "Stores orders")
  }
  Rel(api, queue, "publish", "NATS")
  Rel(admin, queue, "publish", "NATS")
  Rel(queue, db, "Writes", "SQL")
after.description: Synthetic containers where two senders publish to one queue.
steps: Read the native C4 source and its exact authored markers.
Drill only through the declared child levels.

  Container_Boundary(api, "API") {
    Component(intake, "Intake", "Go package", "Validates orders")
    Component(publisher, "Publisher", "Go package", "Publishes orders")
  }
  ContainerQueue(queue, "Order queue", "NATS")
  Rel(intake, publisher, "Hands over")
  Rel(publisher, queue, "publish")
after.description: Synthetic API components; there is no Before side.
